entities.name: Olympic Stadium of Nouakchott
entities.label: Place
entities.summary: The Olympic Stadium is a multi-purpose stadium in Nouakchott, Mauritania. It is used mostly for football matches and has a capacity of 10,000. It also has an athletics track.
